D: Interlinked stories of LA gangsters, boxers and a briefcase.
P: Serve the shakes at Jack Rabbit Slim's.
S: Buddy Holly brings it out to your car booth
Chicken tenders soaked in buttermilk and hot sauce, floured with paprika and garlic, fried deep golden and piled in a basket with honey mustard and lemon.
Mamie Van Doren works the other side of the room
Halved eggs with the yolks whipped up with mayo, Dijon, vinegar and hot sauce, piped back in and topped with smoked paprika, crisp fried shallots and chives.
Vincent's Holland story: they put mayonnaise on fries
Thin fries soaked an hour, blanched at 140C, fried at 190C, salted, served in red-checked paper boats with tomato sauce and mayonnaise.
M: Thick chuck patty brushed with teriyaki (soy, mirin, sugar reduced), grilled pineapple ring, cheddar and lettuce on a toasted bun.
Vincent's order at Jack Rabbit Slim's, cooked rare

Sirloin seared hard and served properly rare, with skin-on fries, a little pot of peppercorn sauce and a crisp iceberg wedge with blue cheese dressing. Season 4 sirloin steaks an hour ahead. Fry 800g frozen skin-on fries at 220C for 25 minutes. Sear the steaks in a smoking pan for 2 minutes a side until 48C inside, then rest 5 minutes. In the same pan, cook 1 chopped shallot and 1 tbsp crushed peppercorns, add 30ml brandy and 150ml cream and simmer 2 minutes. Cut 1 iceberg into wedges and spoon over 120g blue cheese mixed with 80g sour cream.
W: Vincent's pancakes at the diner before the robbery
Buttermilk pancakes cooked in butter, stacked with butter and maple syrup, a side of crisp bacon.
K: Mia's order at Jack Rabbit Slim's, vanilla
Blend 3 scoops vanilla bean ice cream with 120ml cold full cream milk until just thick enough for a straw to stand up. Whipped cream and a cherry.

flavour.sign: Los Angeles. Booths are cars, waiters are film stars.

note.text: Mia picked the place and the five dollar shake. I picked the steak, bloody, and I'm not dancing tonight.

dishes.make_ahead: Soak the chicken in buttermilk up to 1 day ahead; mix the dip up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Soak the chicken in the buttermilk and hot sauce for at least 30 minutes in the fridge.
Mix the flour, paprika, garlic powder and salt. Lift the chicken out, let it drip, then press it into the flour so it gets a shaggy coat.
Fry in oil at 175C in batches for 4 to 5 minutes until deep golden and cooked through. Drain on a rack and salt again.
Stir the honey, mustard and mayonnaise together for dipping.
Pile the chicken into paper-lined baskets with the dip and lemon wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the dip up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Cut the halloumi into thick fingers and soak in the buttermilk and hot sauce for 15 minutes.
Mix the flour, paprika and garlic powder. Lift the halloumi out, let it drip, then press it into the flour so it gets a shaggy coat.
Fry in oil at 180C in batches for 2 to 3 minutes until deep golden. Drain on a rack.
Stir the honey, mustard and mayonnaise together for dipping.
Pile the halloumi into paper-lined baskets with the dip and lemon wedges.

dishes.make_ahead: Boil and fill the eggs up to 1 day ahead, keep covered in the fridge; fry the shallots on the day

steps.text: Lower the eggs into boiling water for 10 minutes, then straight into iced water.
Slice the shallots thin and fry them slowly in the oil until golden and crisp. Drain on paper.
Peel and halve the eggs. Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar and hot sauce until smooth, and season.
Pipe or spoon the yolk back into the whites.
Dust with smoked paprika and top with crisp shallots and snipped chives.

dishes.make_ahead: Cut and soak up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into thin fries.
Soak in cold water for an hour (included in cook time), then dry well.
Fry in oil at 140C for 5 minutes in batches.
Rest the fries on a rack until cool.
Fry again at 190C until crisp, salt and serve in red-checked paper boats with tomato sauce and a pot of mayonnaise, the way they do it in Holland.

dishes.make_ahead: Season the steaks an hour ahead

steps.text: Season the sirloin steaks with salt an hour ahead and leave them out of the fridge.
Bake the frozen skin-on fries at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp.
Heat the oil in a pan until smoking and sear the steaks for 2 minutes a side until 48C inside, then rest them for 5 minutes.
In the same pan cook the shallot and crushed peppercorns for 1 minute, add the brandy and cream and simmer for 2 minutes.
Cut the iceberg lettuce into wedges and spoon over the blue cheese mashed with the sour cream. Serve with the steaks, fries and peppercorn sauce.

af.make_ahead: Season the steaks an hour ahead

steps.text: Season the sirloin steaks with salt an hour ahead and leave them out of the fridge.
Bake the frozen skin-on fries at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp.
Heat the oil in a pan until smoking and sear the steaks for 2 minutes a side until 48C inside, then rest them for 5 minutes.
In the same pan cook the shallot and crushed peppercorns for 1 minute, add the beef stock and let it bubble, then add the cream and simmer for 2 minutes.
Cut the iceberg lettuce into wedges and spoon over the blue cheese mashed with the sour cream. Serve with the steaks, fries and peppercorn sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Mash the blue cheese with the sour cream up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled; cook the cauliflower steaks, fries and sauce on the night

steps.text: Cut two 3cm thick steaks from the middle of each cauliflower, season with salt and brush with 2 tbsp of the oil.
Bake the frozen skin-on fries at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp.
Sear the cauliflower steaks in the remaining oil and the butter in a hot ovenproof pan for 3 minutes a side, then roast at 220C for 15 minutes until tender in the middle.
Wipe out the pan, cook the shallot and crushed peppercorns for 1 minute, add the brandy, stock and cream and simmer for 3 minutes.
Cut the iceberg lettuce into wedges and spoon over the blue cheese mashed with the sour cream. Serve with the cauliflower steaks, fries and peppercorn sauce.

veg_af.make_ahead: Cut the cauliflower steaks and mash the blue cheese with the sour cream up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; sear, roast and make the sauce on the night

steps.text: Cut two 3cm thick steaks from the middle of each cauliflower, season with salt and brush with 2 tbsp of the oil.
Bake the frozen skin-on fries at 220C for 25 minutes until crisp.
Sear the cauliflower steaks in the remaining oil and the butter in a hot ovenproof pan for 3 minutes a side, then roast at 220C for 15 minutes until tender in the middle.
Wipe out the pan, cook the shallot and crushed peppercorns for 1 minute, add the vinegar, water, stock and cream and simmer for 3 minutes.
Cut the iceberg lettuce into wedges and spoon over the blue cheese mashed with the sour cream. Serve with the cauliflower steaks, fries and peppercorn sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Teriyaki glaze up to 3 days ahead

steps.text: Simmer the soy, mirin and sugar until syrupy.
Grill the pineapple rings until charred.
Shape the mince into 4 thick patties.
Grill the patties, brushing with the teriyaki, then melt the cheddar on top.
Toast the buns and build with lettuce, patty and pineapple.

veg.n: Big Kahuna Hawaiian mushroom and haloumi burger
veg.make_ahead: Teriyaki glaze up to 3 days ahead

steps.text: Simmer the soy, mirin and sugar until syrupy.
Grill the pineapple rings until charred.
Brush the mushrooms with the oil and grill them gill side down for 4 minutes, then flip, press flat and cook 4 minutes more, brushing with the teriyaki.
Grill the haloumi slices for 2 minutes a side, brush with teriyaki and sit one on each mushroom. Top with the cheddar to melt.
Toast the buns and build with lettuce, mushroom and haloumi, and pineapple.

veg_af.n: Big Kahuna Hawaiian mushroom and haloumi burger
veg_af.make_ahead: Teriyaki glaze up to 3 days ahead

steps.text: Simmer the soy, apple juice, rice vinegar and sugar until syrupy.
Grill the pineapple rings until charred.
Brush the mushrooms with the oil and grill them gill side down for 4 minutes, then flip, press flat and cook 4 minutes more, brushing with the teriyaki.
Grill the haloumi slices for 2 minutes a side, brush with teriyaki and sit one on each mushroom. Top with the cheddar to melt.
Toast the buns and build with lettuce, mushroom and haloumi, and pineapple.

dishes.make_ahead: Batter up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar, buttermilk and eggs until just combined.
Rest the batter for 15 minutes (included in cook time).
Cook ladlefuls in butter in a frying pan until bubbles set, flip and cook through, keeping the stack warm.
Grill the bacon until crisp. Stack the pancakes with butter and maple syrup, with bacon on the side.

veg.make_ahead: Batter up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, sugar, buttermilk and eggs until just combined.
Rest the batter for 15 minutes.
Cook ladlefuls in butter in a frying pan until bubbles set, flip and cook through, keeping the stack warm.
Fry the smoked tofu in the oil until crisp and brush with a little maple syrup. Stack the pancakes with butter and maple syrup, with the smoky tofu on the side.

dishes.make_ahead: Whip the cream up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge and freeze the glasses up to 1 day ahead; blend the shakes just before serving

steps.text: Blend the ice cream and milk in batches, until just thick enough for a straw to stand up.
Pour into chilled glasses, top with whipped cream and a cherry.

dishes.make_ahead: Best poured just before serving; keep the cola in the fridge and add the vanilla syrup to the glasses up to 1 hour ahead

steps.text: Fill four tall glasses with ice.
Add 15ml vanilla syrup to each glass, or half a teaspoon of vanilla extract with a teaspoon of sugar syrup.
Top each with 300ml cold cola and stir once.

s.note: Vincent's Amsterdam story, the little differences
s.how: Smash 12 small patties from 500g beef mince on a hot griddle, salt and flip, adding American cheese. Put on soft slider buns with diced onion, pickle, mustard and a dab of mayo, the way they do it in Amsterdam.
Cut 1kg russets into thin fries and soak an hour, then dry well. Fry at 140C for 5 minutes, rest, then at 190C until crisp. Salt and serve in red-checked paper boats with tomato sauce and mustard.

m.how: Simmer 60ml soy, 60ml mirin and 2 tbsp brown sugar until syrupy. Grill 4 pineapple rings until charred. Grill 4 thick chuck patties, brushing with the teriyaki, then melt cheddar on top. Build on toasted buns with lettuce and pineapple.

w.note: Vincent's pancakes at the diner before the robbery
w.how: Whisk 300g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 tbsp sugar, 500ml buttermilk and 2 eggs and rest 15 minutes. Cook in butter until bubbles set. Grill 8 rashers of bacon until crisp. Stack the pancakes with butter and maple syrup and bacon on the side.

d.note: vanilla, and it really is worth it
d.how: For each shake, blend 3 scoops vanilla bean ice cream with 120ml cold milk until just thick enough for a straw to stand up. Pour into a chilled glass, top with whipped cream and a cherry. Makes four.
